reason: H0 only exercises decode_image_config followed by the former combined decode_frame API. S1 splits frame metadata parsing into the new public wuffs_gif__decoder__decode_frame_config entry point and introduces call_sequence states 2 and 3, including repeated frame-config calls that invoke wuffs_gif__decoder__skip_frame. H0 neither calls decode_frame_config nor explores these newly explicit call-order paths; it also still uses the removed decode_frame signature, so it is not compatible with S1.
evidence: H0 calls wuffs_gif__decoder__decode_frame(&dec, &fc, &pb, src_reader, ...), passing both frame_config and pixel_buffer.
S1 changes wuffs_gif__decoder__decode_frame to accept only pixel_buffer, source, work buffer, pixbuf_origin_x, and pixbuf_origin_y.
decode_frame_config handles call_sequence values 0, 1, 2, and 3; when call_sequence == 2 it calls wuffs_gif__decoder__skip_frame.
The documented S1 transitions include FC with implicit IC, repeated FC with implicit F/skip_frame, and F with implicit FC, none of which H0 deliberately drives.
recommended_action: Update the harness for the S1 decode_frame signature and add fuzz-controlled protocol variants that call decode_frame_config explicitly, including from the initial state, before decode_frame, repeatedly to trigger skip_frame, and interleaved with decode_frame; validate returned frame_config values and exercise suspension/end-of-data behavior.
